# Browser assets

- KaTeX 0.19.1 supplies the renderer and math fonts. The distribution stylesheet retains WOFF2 sources. See the accompanying license.
- Inter 5.2.8 and Source Serif 4 5.2.9 are the Latin variable builds distributed by Fontsource. Their licenses are included.

The site serves these files from its own origin so typography and math rendering do not depend on third-party font or script requests.
